scenarios.source:
test "intro holds until a name is given"
  expect page = intro
  expect applicant_name visible
  expect applicant_name required
  expect applicant_name enabled
  expect applicant_name editable
  expect applicant_name empty
  continue
  expect page = intro
  expect error on applicant_name
  expect error on applicant_name: required
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  expect applicant_name not empty
  continue
  expect page = contact
  expect no error on applicant_name

test "the age bounds and the calculation"
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 15
  expect age = 15
  expect age != 16
  expect age_next_year = 16
  expect age_next_year = age + 1
  check
  expect refused
  expect error on age: number.min
  set age = 30
  check
  expect accepted
  expect no errors

test "the nickname follows the details box"
  expect nickname disabled
  set wants_details = true
  expect nickname enabled
  set applicant_name = "Locked"
  expect nickname readonly
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  expect nickname editable

test "email is required when it is the way to reach you"
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  continue
  expect page = contact
  expect email optional
  set contact_method = "email"
  expect email required
  continue
  expect page = contact
  expect error on email: required

test "the confirmation must match the email"
  given journey = none
  set email = "a@example.com"
  set confirm_email = "b@example.com"
  check
  expect refused
  expect error on confirm_email: rule
  expect message on confirm_email = "The two emails must match."
  set confirm_email = "a@example.com"
  check
  expect no error on confirm_email

test "the confirmation message in French"
  given journey = none
  given locale = "fr"
  set email = "a@example.com"
  set confirm_email = "b@example.com"
  check
  expect error on confirm_email: rule
  expect message on confirm_email = "Les deux courriels doivent correspondre."

test "a hidden phone is withheld, a hidden pet name is kept"
  given journey = none
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  set contact_method = "phone"
  set phone = "555-0100"
  expect phone visible
  set contact_method = "email"
  set email = "a@example.com"
  set confirm_email = "a@example.com"
  expect phone hidden
  set has_pet = false
  set pet_name = "Rex"
  expect pet_name hidden
  submit
  expect accepted
  expect phone withheld
  expect submitted pet_name = "Rex"
  expect submitted applicant_name = "Ada"

test "STOP routes to the exit page"
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  continue
  set stop_code = "STOP"
  continue
  expect page = stop
  expect path = (intro, contact, stop)
  expect path ends at stop
  expect review off path

test "the details page is skipped unless asked for"
  expect details off path
  expect path = (intro, contact, review)
  expect path ends
  set wants_details = true
  expect details on path
  expect path = (intro, contact, details, review)

test "an answer on a skipped page is withheld"
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  set wants_details = true
  set has_pet = true
  set wants_details = false
  submit
  expect accepted
  expect has_pet withheld

test "Back and a jump move between pages"
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  continue
  expect page = contact
  back
  expect page = intro
  go to contact
  expect page = contact

test "rows are added, answered and removed"
  given journey = none
  expect rows of items = 0
  add row to items with qty = 2
  add row to items
  expect rows of items = 2
  expect items[0].qty = 2
  set items[1].qty = 5
  expect items[1].qty = 5
  remove row 0 of items
  expect rows of items = 1
  expect items[0].qty = 5

test "the pets layout when there is a pet"
  given journey = none
  expect layout = standard
  set has_pet = true
  expect layout = pets

test "topics read through a formula"
  given journey = none
  expect topics empty
  set topics = ("news", "events")
  expect topics not empty
  expect count(selected(topics)) = 2
  set topics = ()
  expect topics empty

test "a province from the given options"
  given journey = none
  given options for province = ("ON", "QC")
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 30
  set province = "QC"
  submit
  expect accepted
  expect submitted province = "QC"

test "an admin sees the role note"
  given journey = none
  given host.role = "admin"
  expect role_note visible

test "anyone else does not see the role note"
  given journey = none
  given host.role = "user"
  expect role_note hidden

test "a server-only check is not the browser's to judge"
  given journey = none
  set ref_number = "BAD"
  check
  expect error on ref_number: rule
